name: Stop / Go (STOP/RY-GO)
meaning: Two signs mounted back to back, used mostly at road works: stop when STOP is shown; proceed with caution when GO is shown.

name: Stop
meaning: Stop behind the stop line (or in line with the sign if there is no line); proceed only when it is safe.

name: Stop / yield (left turn)
meaning: Stop if going straight or turning right; traffic turning left may do so without stopping, but must yield to all traffic close enough to be a hazard.

name: 3-way stop
meaning: All three approaches must stop; the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.

name: 4-way stop
meaning: All four approaches must stop; the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.

name: Yield
meaning: Yield to other traffic: slow down and stop if necessary.

name: Yield to pedestrians
meaning: Give priority to pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross; be ready to stop.

name: Yield at traffic circle (mini-circle)
meaning: Yield to vehicles already in the circle or that will cross their yield line before you cross yours; first to reach the yield line goes first.

name: No entry
meaning: No traffic may proceed past the sign (e.g. the wrong end of a one-way street).

name: One-way roadway (to the left)
meaning: The road in the direction of the arrow is a one-way roadway.

name: One-way roadway (ahead)
meaning: The road ahead is a one-way roadway.

name: Pedestrian priority
meaning: Area intended for pedestrians; only emergency, loading/off-loading and maintenance vehicles, max 15 km/h, giving pedestrians priority.

name: Yield to oncoming traffic
meaning: Single carriageway ahead for both directions: yield to vehicles already in it.

name: Minimum speed (50 km/h)
meaning: Do not drive slower than the speed shown.

name: Vehicles exceeding 10 t only
meaning: Vehicles with a GVM/GCM over the mass shown must use this road or lane.

name: Keep left
meaning: Pass to the left of the obstruction.

name: Keep right
meaning: Pass to the right of the obstruction.

name: Proceed left only
meaning: Drive only in the direction of the arrow (left).

name: Turn left only
meaning: At the intersection ahead you must turn left.

name: Turn right only
meaning: At the intersection ahead you must turn right.

name: Pedestrians only
meaning: Road or part of road for pedestrians only.

name: Pedal cyclists only
meaning: Road or part of road for cyclists only.

name: Cyclists and pedestrians only (divided)
meaning: Divided path: cyclists use the side with the bicycle, pedestrians the side with the pedestrian.

name: Motorcycles only
meaning: Road or lane for motorcycles only.

name: Motorcycles only (temporary)
meaning: Temporary version: road or lane for motorcycles only.

name: Motor cars only
meaning: Road or lane for motor cars only.

name: Taxis only
meaning: Road or lane set aside for taxis.

name: Minibuses only
meaning: Road or lane set aside for minibuses.

name: Buses only
meaning: Road or lane set aside for buses.

name: Delivery vehicles only
meaning: Road or lane set aside for delivery vehicles.

name: Goods vehicles only
meaning: Road or lane set aside for goods vehicles.

name: Construction vehicles only
meaning: Road set aside for construction vehicles.

name: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances only
meaning: Road set aside for vehicles conveying dangerous goods.

name: Abnormal vehicles only
meaning: Road set aside for abnormal vehicles.

name: Tour buses only
meaning: Road set aside for tour buses.

name: Agricultural vehicles only
meaning: Road set aside for agricultural vehicles.

name: Animal-drawn vehicles only
meaning: Road set aside for animal-drawn vehicles.

name: Pay toll
meaning: Last chance to take an alternative route; if you carry on, you must pay toll.

name: Switch headlamps on
meaning: Switch on your headlights (dipped) to see and be seen, e.g. before a tunnel.

name: Roundabout
meaning: Move clockwise; yield to vehicles approaching from the right within the roundabout.

name: Speed limit 100 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed 100 km/h; the limit applies from the sign.

name: Speed limit 60 km/h
meaning: Do not exceed 60 km/h; the limit applies from the sign.

name: Temporary speed limit 100 km/h
meaning: Temporary speed limit: do not exceed 100 km/h.

name: Mass limit (12 t)
meaning: Vehicles with GVM/GCM over 12 t may not use this road.

name: Axle mass limit (2 t)
meaning: Vehicles with any axle heavier than the mass shown may not use this road.

name: Height limit (4,42 m)
meaning: Vehicles (including load) higher than 4,42 m may not proceed.

name: Length limit (15 m)
meaning: Vehicles longer than 15 m may not proceed.

name: Excessive noise prohibited
meaning: No excessive noise; do not use your hooter for 100 m after the sign.

name: Hitch-hiking prohibited
meaning: Pedestrians may not hitch-hike and drivers may not pick up passengers for the next 500 m.

name: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited
meaning: Do not proceed past the sign without special permission.

name: Left turn ahead prohibited
meaning: You may not turn left at the intersection ahead.

name: Right turn ahead prohibited
meaning: You may not turn right at the intersection ahead.

name: Left turn prohibited
meaning: No left turn here; you may go straight or turn right.

name: Right turn prohibited
meaning: No right turn here; you may go straight or turn left.

name: U-turn prohibited
meaning: Do not turn your vehicle around to face the opposite direction.

name: Overtaking prohibited
meaning: Do not overtake any vehicle for the next 500 m.

name: Overtaking prohibited for goods vehicles
meaning: Drivers of heavy (goods) vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles for the next 500 m.

name: Parking prohibited
meaning: Do not park here (you may stop briefly).

name: Stopping prohibited
meaning: Do not stop, except to obey a traffic light or officer, or to avoid a collision.

name: Pedestrians prohibited
meaning: Pedestrians may not proceed; still watch out for them.

name: Pedal cycles prohibited
meaning: Cyclists may not proceed past the sign.

name: Pedal cycles and pedestrians prohibited
meaning: Cyclists and pedestrians may not proceed past the sign.

name: Motorcycles prohibited
meaning: Motorcycles may not enter (on a freeway, leave at the first exit).

name: Motor cars prohibited
meaning: Motor cars may not enter.

name: Taxis prohibited
meaning: Taxis may not proceed beyond the sign.

name: Minibuses prohibited
meaning: Minibuses may not proceed beyond the sign.

name: Buses prohibited
meaning: Buses may not proceed beyond the sign.

name: Goods vehicles prohibited
meaning: Goods vehicles may not proceed beyond the sign.

name: Vehicles transporting dangerous substances prohibited
meaning: Vehicles carrying dangerous goods may not proceed.

name: Agricultural vehicles prohibited
meaning: Tractors / agricultural vehicles may not proceed.

name: Animal-drawn vehicles prohibited
meaning: Animal-drawn vehicles may not proceed.

name: Horses and riders prohibited
meaning: Horses and riders (mounted or leading) may not proceed.

name: Width limit (2,1 m)
meaning: Vehicles wider than 2,1 m may not proceed.

name: Towed vehicles prohibited
meaning: No vehicle towing another vehicle or trailer may proceed.

name: Hawkers prohibited
meaning: Hawkers prohibited; do not stop or park for hawkers here.

name: Bus stop reservation
meaning: Only buses of the indicated operator may stop here to pick up or drop off passengers.

name: Dual-carriageway freeway begins
meaning: A dual-carriageway freeway (separate roadways for each direction) begins; freeway rules apply from here.

name: Single-carriageway freeway begins
meaning: A single-carriageway freeway (one roadway carrying both directions) begins; freeway rules apply from here.

name: Woonerf
meaning: Residential "living street": max 30 km/h, pedestrians have right of way, no through traffic, no vehicles over 3 500 kg or with more than 10 seats except local access/delivery.

name: Daytime (supplementary plate)
meaning: The sign above it applies during daytime only.

name: Night-time (supplementary plate)
meaning: The sign above it applies at night only.

name: Pay and display
meaning: Pay the parking fee and display the receipt in your vehicle.

name: Crossroad
meaning: A crossroad is ahead: approach cautiously and be able to stop.

name: Priority crossroad
meaning: Crossroad ahead where YOU have right of way (thicker line = priority road); still be ready to stop if cross-traffic does not yield.

name: Secondary crossroad
meaning: Crossroad ahead where you must yield to cross-traffic (the thick line is the priority road).

name: T-junction
meaning: Road ends at a T-junction ahead: you will have to turn left or right.

name: Side road junction from the left
meaning: A side road joins from the left ahead.

name: Side road junction from the right
meaning: A side road joins from the right ahead.

name: Y-junction
meaning: The road forks into two roads ahead.

name: Traffic circle ahead
meaning: Traffic circle ahead; slow down and be ready to yield.

name: Gentle curve to the right
meaning: A gentle curve to the right is ahead.

name: Gentle curve to the left
meaning: A gentle curve to the left is ahead.

name: Sharp curve to the right
meaning: A sharp curve to the right is ahead: slow down.

name: Sharp curve to the left
meaning: A sharp curve to the left is ahead: slow down.

name: Hairpin bend to the right
meaning: A very sharp U-shaped curve to the right is ahead.

name: Hairpin bend to the left
meaning: A very sharp U-shaped curve to the left is ahead.

name: Winding road
meaning: A series of curves is ahead (more may follow without further warning).

name: Two-way traffic
meaning: The one-way road you are on will soon carry two-way traffic.

name: Two-way traffic crossroad
meaning: Your one-way street will be crossed by a street with two-way traffic.

name: Traffic signals ahead
meaning: Traffic lights ahead: slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Stop sign ahead
meaning: A stop sign is ahead that you may not see in time: slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Yield sign ahead
meaning: A yield sign is ahead: slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Traffic control (officer) ahead
meaning: A traffic officer is controlling traffic ahead.

name: Scholar patrol ahead
meaning: A scholar patrol is operating ahead: slow down and watch for children and the stop sign.

name: Pedestrian crossing ahead
meaning: A demarcated pedestrian crossing is ahead; do not overtake vehicles stopped at it.

name: Pedestrians
meaning: Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km.

name: Children
meaning: Children may be crossing or playing in the road.

name: Pedal cyclists
meaning: Cyclists may be on or crossing the road for the next 2 km.

name: Domestic animals (cattle)
meaning: Free-roaming domestic animals may be on the road for the next 2 km.

name: Wild animals
meaning: Wild animals may be on or crossing the road for the next 2 km.

name: Gate
meaning: A gate or boom across the road is ahead.

name: Railway crossing ahead
meaning: A railway crossing is ahead: slow down, look both ways and stop in time if a train is coming.

name: Tunnel
meaning: A tunnel is ahead: slow down and switch on headlights (dipped).

name: Height restriction ahead (4,42 m)
meaning: A structure ahead is only 4,42 m high.

name: Slow-moving heavy vehicles
meaning: Heavy vehicles travel slowly on the steep road ahead.

name: Gravel road begins
meaning: The tarred road changes to gravel: slow down, steering is lighter and stopping distances longer.

name: Narrow bridge
meaning: The road narrows over a bridge: try not to cross at the same time as an oncoming vehicle.

name: One-vehicle-width structure
meaning: Only one vehicle at a time can pass: if there is oncoming traffic, stop at least 6 m from the structure and yield.

name: Road narrows from both sides
meaning: The road ahead narrows from both sides.

name: Uneven roadway
meaning: A dip, ridge or potholes ahead.

name: Speed humps
meaning: Speed humps ahead: slow down.

name: Slippery road
meaning: Unusually slippery road ahead for the next 2 km: avoid sudden braking or steering.

name: Falling rocks
meaning: Rocks could fall onto the road.

name: Road works
meaning: Temporary construction or maintenance works ahead.

name: Grader working
meaning: A grader is working on the road ahead.

name: General warning
meaning: Danger of some kind ahead.

name: Soft shoulder
meaning: The road shoulder is soft: do not drive or stop on it.

name: Stop/Go control ahead
meaning: Traffic ahead is controlled by a Stop/Go sign: slow down and get ready to stop.

name: Truck crossing (temporary)
meaning: Heavy vehicles regularly cross or join the road ahead.

name: Emergency flashing light
meaning: Hazard ahead; look out for signs showing what it is.

name: Temporary police flashing light
meaning: Police on duty ahead (roadblock, collision scene): be ready to stop.

name: Jetty edge or river bank
meaning: The road leads to a jetty edge or river bank.

name: Crosswinds
meaning: Strong crosswinds may push your vehicle off course.

name: Drift
meaning: A drift (low water crossing) ahead may be flooded.

name: Low-flying aircraft
meaning: Low-flying aircraft and sudden noise: do not brake suddenly.

name: Agricultural vehicles
meaning: Tractors or slow farm vehicles may cross or enter the road.

name: Collision ahead
meaning: A collision scene is ahead: slow down and be ready to stop; do not stop out of curiosity.

name: Reduced visibility
meaning: Fog or smoke may reduce visibility ahead.

name: Congestion
meaning: Congested traffic may be ahead.

name: Horses and riders
meaning: Horses and riders may be on the road ahead.

name: Elephants
meaning: Elephants may be on the road ahead.

name: Width restriction ahead (2,1 m)
meaning: The road ahead is restricted to vehicles 2,1 m wide or less.

name: Electrical shock
meaning: Risk of electrical shock from overhead power cables ahead.

name: Railway crossing (single track)
meaning: A railway crossing with one track; if no stop line, stop no closer than 3 m from the nearest rail.

name: Sharp curve chevron (curve to the left)
meaning: The road curves sharply to the left; slow down.

name: Traffic signals out of order
meaning: The traffic lights ahead are not working: slow down, yield and be ready to stop.

name: Cul-de-sac (side road to the right)
meaning: The side road to the right is a dead end (no through road).

name: Right of way
meaning: You have right of way at the intersection ahead.

name: Information centre
meaning: Information office or notice board.

name: Co-ordinated traffic signals
meaning: If you keep to the speed shown, the following traffic lights should be green (a recommendation, not a limit).

name: Multi-phase traffic signals
meaning: These lights do not follow the normal sequence: wait for your own green, even if opposing traffic moves.

name: Bus stop ahead
meaning: A bus stop is ahead.
